name: Time Hollow ~Ubawareta Kako o Motomete~
original_name: Time Hollow ～奪われた過去を求めて～
source:
Life is full of regrets...if only we had the power to change the past.

Ethan is a perfectly ordinary high school student who lives with his parents. The day before he turns 17, he has a strange dream... when he awakes he is separated from his parents, but in possession of a device that can control time.

[from the back of the box of the european release of Time Hollow]
translation:
人生充满遗憾……要是我们拥有改变过去的力量就好了。

伊森是一名与父母共同生活的普通高中生。17岁生日前一天，他做了一个奇怪的梦……醒来后，他与父母分离，手中却多出了一台能够控制时间的装置。

[摘自《Time Hollow》欧洲版包装盒背面]
